handled_verified._description: Analyzer-referenced node types with probe/fixture-verified behavior (real-erlang-analyzer.ts at the ER wave, 2026-09-18): arity identity #880 (verify-erlang-identity.ts), call-site arity ER-D2 (fixture erlang/arity-distinct-calls), behaviours (erlang/behaviour-otp), records (erlang/record-ops), call resolution incl. forward references (erlang/call-resolution), pattern-position negatives (erlang/negative-noise), exports (erlang/arity-exports). Include-path extraction and macro-name extraction probed live 2026-09-17.

internal_silent._description: Grammar-internal containers, literals, comments, control-flow wrappers and attribute metadata that correctly emit nothing (no relationship semantics in the analyzer's contract). PP conditionals follow the haskell `cpp` precedent: conditional compilation is not modeled, silently. anonymous_fun follows the family lambda precedent (a value with no name, nothing to resolve).

gap._description: Confirmed missing emissions, numbered ER-G1.. (tracked work items, not gate failures). Differential floor context: rebar3 exercises macro uses and fun references heavily; OTP (second corpus) additionally exercises callbacks and record member reads.

gaps.missing: macro USES (?MACRO) emit no references edge to the pp_define constant symbol — the declaration is a symbol, every use of it is invisible (php constants emit references; family precedent)
fun-value references (fun f/1, fun lists:map/2) emit no references/calls edge — a semantic reference to a declared or remote function is dropped

-callback declarations (behaviour interface contracts) emit no Method symbol — the implements edge fires from -behaviour alone and the callback signatures are invisible (haskell class signatures emit Method owned by Interface, HS-D8)

record member reads (S#state.field, #state.field index reads) emit no uses edge to the record_field Property symbol — fields are emitted as symbols on declaration but every read is invisible (java/kotlin member-read parity, #739/#740 family)
-opaque type declarations emit no Type symbol (type_alias branch handles -type only)

design_decision.description: Erlang BEAM-family contract (ER wave, #275/#880, ruled 2026-09-18): arity is function identity (module:name/arity), remote-call targets keep module qualification, records map onto the universal struct/property model, behaviours are implements-only, specs annotate rather than declare.

decisions.question: Remote call target convention: stored `module:function` vs the oracle prose's bare 'leaf'.
decisions.resolution: RULED: the target KEEPS `module:function` — the separator is semantic (a bare reply would conflate every module's reply; family precedent: php A::m, ruby A::B, cpp ns::n keep their separators). Pinned by mutant erlang/remote-target-unqualified (behaviour-otp) and forbid `calls go -> format` in arity-distinct-calls. The F5 oracle (deriveErlangEdges) mirrors the qualified target.

decisions.question: #880 obligation 4: is call-site arity part of relationship identity? The 3-field (source|type|target) dedup merged pick/1 and pick/2 call sites into one edge.
decisions.resolution: RULED: arity joins the identity — symbols are module:name/arity (distinct rows, java-overload convention of same-name symbols distinguished by arity metadata); call edges carry metadata.callArity (the call's expr_args named-children count, comments excluded, same counter as clause heads) and dedup on source|type|target|callArity. Local targets stay BARE names (bind to the same-named symbol rows exactly like java overloads); remote targets stay qualified (ER-D1). Binding of a bare name to same-named arity rows follows the family convention — the family-wide binding ambiguity is tracked by M59, not solved per-language here. Pinned by verify-erlang-identity.ts (call-identity checks + 4 mutations) and fixture erlang/arity-distinct-calls; mutants erlang/call-arity-collapsed + erlang/remote-call-arity-lost.

decisions.question: -spec declarations: standalone symbol or annotation?
decisions.resolution: RULED: specs are type annotations for the function that follows — the fun_decl emits the symbol, the spec emits nothing standalone. type_sig/fun_type internals are silent containers.

decisions.question: Record updates (S#state{...}) vs constructions (#state{...}) — both are record-shaped expressions.
decisions.resolution: RULED: only record_expr in non-head position is construction (instantiates -> record). Updates are member mutation of an existing value — no instantiates. Pinned by erlang/negative-noise (pattern-position record literals forbidden) and erlang/record-ops; mutant erlang/pattern-record-instantiates. The READ half (record_field_expr etc.) is declared gap ER-G4, not silently ruled away.

decisions.question: Map expressions: construction/reads like records, or silent?
decisions.resolution: RULED: maps carry no type identity in Erlang (#{...} is structural, any key/value) — unlike records there is no declared name to resolve, so construction and reads emit nothing. field_expr (map member read) is silent for the same reason.

decisions.question: -behaviour(b): a symbol for the behaviour contract, an implements edge, or nothing?
decisions.resolution: RULED: the Implements edge only, never a standalone symbol — the behaviour is a cross-module contract the module fulfills. OTP behaviours additionally mark the Actor Model (OTP)/OTP Behaviours patterns. Pinned by erlang/behaviour-otp. The -callback declaration half is gap ER-G3.
